about: Every knob of the body-driven fluid page. landmarks = which body points paint and how; particles = how each landmark's movement becomes splats; simulation = the fluid's own per-frame dials, applied onto the sim's config. body_pointers.js refuses to run without this file. URL parameters (?vel= etc.) still override for bench tuning.
landmarks_doc: index = COCO-17 position in body_state.payload.keypoints (0 nose, 1/2 eyes, 3/4 ears, 5/6 shoulders, 7/8 elbows, 9/10 wrists, 11/12 hips, 13/14 knees, 15/16 ankles). hue = fixed colour 0..1 around the wheel. force = how hard this landmark pushes the flow. dye = how much colour it deposits (kept separate from force so flow can be strong while the scene stays dim).
particles_doc: splat_velocity = movement to flow-push scale (2400 targets incense smoke; 9000 was a fire hose). sub_splats = particles laid along each frame's movement path. jitter = scatter around that path, texcoord units. dye_brightness = master brightness over every landmark's dye. emit_mode = trail (brush stroke) or ring (expanding puff; ring settings below apply). max_step = jump treated as a teleport, not a stroke. smoothing = per-frame approach toward the newest sample. idle_ms = no body for this long drops all pointers. min_visibility = landmark confidence floor (matches the server's own threshold).
simulation_doc: Applied onto the simulation's live config after it boots. DYE_RESOLUTION / SIM_RESOLUTION are allowed too: the loader rebuilds the framebuffers when either is present. The panel's Save button rewrites this whole file from the live values (needs the TouchFree app behind the page). gravity is a TouchFree addition: positive rises like smoke, negative falls like water, 0 is upstream. curl = vorticity, what makes smoke curl. splat_radius small = fine wisps. density_dissipation = how fast colour fades. velocity_dissipation = how fast motion dies (low = keeps drifting). bloom_intensity high washes the scene to white.
